title: Grateful Dead Live at Robert F. Kennedy Stadium on 1990-07-12
lineage: (dat clone from master) Tascam DA20 Mark II DAT > Roland SRC-2 sample rate/format converter (from SPDIF to Optical) > Mac Mini > Audacity 3.0 at 48K > Wave
source: flac16/48kHz; Rick Katzeff Recording: Spaced Schoeps CMC32s @ 8 1/2' > Panasonic SV250 > DAT [FOB]; John Ammons

ai_review.summary: Excellent performance highlighted by a superb Dark Star and strong setlist, with an apparently clean recording.
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates this show five stars, calling it one of the best from ’78‑’95 and praising Dark Star, Feel Like a Stranger, Tennessee Jed, The Music Never Stopped and the Watchtower>Fantasy sequence. No specific recording complaints are noted, suggesting the FLAC source is at least listenable, while Jerry’s guitar tone on his Rosebud is highlighted as “deliciously sweet”.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewer gives a perfect score for the musical performance, and although recording details are scarce, no issues are mentioned, implying good quality; combined weight yields a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit comments on soundboard vs. audience; reviewer focuses on performance, indicating the FLAC source is acceptable with no noticeable flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall show described as outstanding and tightly energetic, with high intensity throughout and seamless transitions into the drum segment.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for an exceptionally sweet tone on his Rosebud guitar, sounding richer than his previous Tiger and incorporating midi effects.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mention of a smooth “sweet trail‑off into Drums” after Dark Star.
